Dialogs.Dialog: Fountain Park

Fountain Park sits a short walk from Shintowano Station. With cherry blossoms in spring and ginkgo in autumn, it shows a different face every season and is a favorite place for Towano residents to unwind. It's busy all year round, weekdays and weekends alike.
Small Park

This park, with only a few pieces of playground equipment and a plaza, has no specific name. Citizens affectionately call it "Small Park", and it's a hidden favorite that always ranks high in surveys of favorite spots.
Shintowano Station

For Towano High students, Shintowano Station is the nearest station to school, and the area around it is always busy with students. The stretch between Shintowano Station and Towano Station is the city's main street, lined with Electric Town and entertainment spots.
Dixie's
Dixie's is a family restaurant chain operating mainly in Towano. It's been loved by the citizens for its sweets. Recently, a rival restaurant has entered and has been in the news.
Toji Temple

Toji Temple, a branch of the head temple in Okutowano, is a famous temple over 400 years old. Being easier to reach than the head temple, it draws worshippers from inside and outside the city all year round, not just at New Year.
Western-style Mansion
An old Western-style mansion whose lavish design catches many eyes. Nobody knows who lived there or why it was built, and lately there are even rumors of a Dracula legend.
Towano Station

Judging by the size of the station, its daily passengers and the bustle around it, it's no exaggeration to call this Towano's main terminal. It sits in the center of the city and is the gateway for residents heading out of town.
Arcade
This popular amusement facility offers the latest game machines and large medal machines. Not only new items but also retro games are available, and they are popular among retro game fans.
Electric Town

The Towano Station end of the main street between Shintowano and Towano stations used to be an electronics district lined with appliance stores. Now, with game shops and anime shops too, it's a major entertainment district.
Towano Castle

The historic ruins of Towano Castle used to have only an outer moat and stone walls remaining, but now the castle tower has been restored and the park has become a popular destination for many tourists.
TV Station
"Towano TV" is a local station known for bold programming only a local broadcaster could pull off, while staying close to the community. You can tell from the shows how much the staff love Towano.
Towanosakaue Station

Towanosakaue grew into a suburban commuter town as Towano was redeveloped in recent years. It's packed with large entertainment and cultural facilities, like the amusement park, the botanical garden and the indoor pool.
Amusement Park
Spark World is the only amusement park in Towano and is an undeniably popular spot. The symbol of the park is the Ferris Wheel, and its spectacular view is a regular date course for many couples.
Indoor Pool
A large, heated swimming pool facility that can be enjoyed in swimsuits throughout the year. In addition to a flowing pool and water slides, couples can also enjoy refreshments.
Riverbed

The Towano River is the symbol of Towanohigashi. Its riverbanks are well kept, and the promenade and embankment are popular running courses. The sunset seen from the embankment is said to be beautiful.
Seaside Station

In Towano's recent redevelopment, the area around Seaside Station has grown faster than anywhere else. Making good use of the wide open space here, it's become a commercial district popular with young people, lined with large shopping and entertainment facilities.
Event Hall

A cluster of multipurpose facilities a short walk from Seaside Station. Parks, large and small halls and a mid-sized stadium are grouped together, and live shows, exhibitions and other events are held almost every day.
Mall
The flagship shopping complex of the Seaside Station district, home to many shops focused on fashion and lifestyle goods. It's popular mainly with young people and busy every day.
Sky Tower

Sky Tower is one of the Seaside Area's top sights, alongside the Bay Bridge and Harbour Hill Park. It's admired as fine architecture, but it actually doubles as a large lighthouse and is still in service.
Harbour Hill Park

Harbour Hill Park sits on a hill overlooking the harbor, Sky Tower, the Seaside Area and the coast, hence the name. Maybe it's the view, but in a city full of green parks, it's one of the most popular.
Bay Bridge

The Bay Bridge is popular not only among residents but also among tourists visiting the city by car. However, during the bathing season, the bridge becomes heavily congested, and there are strong requests for improvement from nearby residents.
Aquarium

"Towano Aquarium," halfway between the harbor side and the beach side of the Seaside Area, keeps very rare deep-sea fish such as the goblin shark alive on display, drawing many visitors from inside and outside the city.
Beach

Towano City's beach is visited by many bathers during the swimming season because there is little garbage and the water and sand quality is good. Seasonal beach houses also seem to be a hidden gourmet spot.
Chinese Restaurant
There are plenty of Chinese restaurants around Seaside Station, but this one is known for its high-quality food despite being a chain. Word is it's planning more branches in Towano.
Fish Market

The fish market keeps Towano's kitchens stocked. The harbor district that grew up around it is now a commercial area popular with young people, but the market is as lively as ever. You might find something fresh here.
Pier
Passenger ships, cargo ships and fishing boats all dock at this pier. Lately, the bay cruises from here have been quietly gaining attention as a way to escape the everyday.
Okutowano Station

Head north from Towanosakaue and up into the hills, and you reach Okutowano, Towano's mountain retreat. It's a historic place of mountain worship, with plenty of sights such as an art museum, a zoo and a ski resort.
Lake

Lake Towano is famous for its clear water, and its swan-shaped sightseeing boats are popular. It's a spot outside the city where you can forget the hustle and bustle and take things slow. Lately, sightings of an unidentified creature have been the talk of the town.
Museum on the Mountain
"Towano Museum of Art" lets visitors enjoy first-rate art amid the nature of Okutowano. It covers a wide range of genres and, despite being out in the suburbs, is popular with people of all ages.
Zoo on the Mountain

"Towano Zoo" is a popular zoo with activity-based exhibits, drawing many visitors from inside and outside the city. The chance to hold baby animals is a big hit, with long lines forming before it starts.
Amou Mountain

Amou Mountain is the symbol of Towano. Its peaks look like ten spread wings, which is said to be the origin of the name "Towano." Lately it's become known as a popular getaway for enjoying nature without much effort.
Plateau

Perhaps thanks to the recent eco boom, Okutowano's highland area has been drawing attention. With marshes where rare alpine plants bloom, ranches and farms, it's gaining notice as an eco-friendly tourist spot.
Okutowano Onsen

Okutowano has become hugely popular as a tourist destination in recent years, and Okutowano Onsen is part of the reason. The water is excellent, and the charm of its rustic hot spring town may be the secret to its popularity.
Waterfall
Okutowano's biggest draw is how easily you can enjoy nature so close to the city. This famous waterfall, even called "the Kegon of Okutowano," has been drawing lots of tourists lately.
Towano High School

Towano High School, a private school, has a long history and an appealing free-spirited culture, drawing many applicants from inside and outside the city every year. It holds lots of events throughout the year, and the students seem to join in eagerly.
Library

Towano High's library is famous for its large, varied collection. Lately there's been talk around school about a strikingly beautiful girl on the library committee who's extremely strict with patrons.
Tennis Court
Towano High's tennis club is as free-spirited as the school. Its goal is friendship through tennis, and the mixed doubles friendly matches it holds now and then are popular with most members.
Behind the School

The back of Towano High's school building is ordinary and deserted. But there's a rumor passed down among students for years: confess to the one you love behind the school building, and it'll work out.
Courtyard

The courtyard of Towano High School is a well-kept garden with a central sculpture, and is the most popular spot on campus where many students can be seen reading or chatting after school or during lunch breaks.
Sports Ground

The sports festival held in September is one of the school's biggest events, and many students look forward to it. It has a wide variety of events and, unusually for a high school sports festival, even a borrowing race.
Pool
Towano High's pool is a perfectly standard 25-meter pool with six lanes. The pool opening every July has no special events, but it's a quietly popular occasion the boys look forward to.
Rooftop
With no tall buildings nearby and the school sitting on a gentle hill, you can see all the way to the bay area from the roof. Students treat the view as a hidden gem.
Cafeteria

The school cafeteria at Towano High School has a reputation among students and teachers alike for the variety and taste of its menu. However, the price per item is not different from that of a regular restaurant.
School Shop
Like the school cafeteria, Towano High School's school shop has a large selection of items, even items unrelated to schoolwork, and sometimes even rare items that can only be found here.
Towanohigashi Station
Towanohigashi Station is the gateway to Towanohigashi, an up-and-coming area. It combines the calm of the Towano River and its banks with the energy of its many art spaces and specialty shops.
Shopping Area
Unlike the shopping mall in the Seaside Area, the Towanohigashi shopping area is known for its specialty stores, which draw all kinds of enthusiasts from inside and outside the city.
Camera Shop
One of the specialty stores in the shopping area is this camera shop. It carries a huge range of camera parts, and sometimes even gets in legendary items that big stores never stock.
Gallery
Another side of Towanohigashi is its cutting-edge art scene. The seasonal photo exhibitions in particular showcase impressive work submitted from all over the country and draw big crowds.
Restaurant
Another charm of Towanohigashi is relaxing over a meal after touring the specialty shops and taking in the art scene. It's a small area, but many restaurants compete here.
Cookware Shop

When it comes to unusual specialty shops, this cookware shop takes the prize. More and more couples have been visiting lately, and some experts think Towano may be in the middle of a home-cooking boom.
